messages:
Alex: Quick sync — Q2 initiative handshake for SmartServe rollout. Need alignment across product / eng / runtime / infra / security. Goal: production rollout in ~6 weeks. Three hard deps: runtime sharding, infra egress & VLANs, security KMS/audit. Who owns what and dates?

Maya: can you list owners + must-dates? product needs to lock comms and SDK changes.

Alex: Owners: Runtime -> Samir, Infra -> Priya, Security -> Jess, Product -> Alex. Must-dates (target): runtime sharding by 1769180000, infra network by 1769250000, security audit by 1769350000. If any blocker call it out now.

Samir: runtime notes: to support sticky per-customer KV sharding we need two focused sprints: KV rekey + sharding layer + canary hooks. ETA: ~8 dev days + 4 infra integration days. Blocker: model artifact versioning and fingerprinting. cc @Priya for canary infra.

Priya: infra can stand up VLANs and ACLs, but we need final CIDR ranges and expected p95 traffic numbers. ETA once spec is final: ~3 weeks. Also config propagation path required for feature toggles.

Jess: security asks: threat model + KMS key rotation plan + audit checklist. Without a minimal checklist we can't sign off; will cause release hold.

Alex: quick spec snippet (for context):
```text
- API compatibility: unchanged
- KV cache: sticky shard per customer id
- Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over N days
- Rollback: model fallback to v1 artifacts + metric gate
- Feature toggles: runtime-level flag + infra-propagated config
```

Maya: product needs API toggles by 1769140000 so SDK & docs can ship. Can runtime expose toggle endpoint?

Samir: yes runtime can expose a flag endpoint, but needs config service to push changes atomically. Propose using feature-flags topic in config service.

Priya: agree. We need flag schema (key, type, signed_by, ttl) and propagation frequency (realtime vs 5m). Also signing requirement from security.

Jess: we can sign configs with KMS and issue short-lived tokens for fetch. Need to know operations: who creates/rotates keys and KMS access policy.

SRE-Bot: Deploy window proposed: 1769760000 (2026-05-01 02:00 UTC). Auto-rollback if error rate >= 5% or latency p95 spikes > 2x baseline.

Alex: Action items / RACI: Product (A) Alex, Runtime (R) Samir, Infra (R) Priya, Security (C) Jess, SRE (I) Ops.
- Samir: post PR with timeline & config schema by EOD (1769127600)
- Priya: confirm VLAN/CIDR and traffic expectations by Tue (1769203200)
- Jess: provide minimal security checklist + KMS rotation plan by next Wed (1769289600)
- Maya: draft customer comms + SDK notes by 1769143600

Maya: I will draft comms and coordinate with support for talk tracks.

Samir: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/542 — includes config schema draft and canary hooks.

Jess: reviewing PR now, will attach checklist comments shortly. :thumbsup:

Priya: noted. I'll validate VLAN ranges and post a diagram in #eng-infra.

Alex: thanks team. If infra or security show blockers, ping me and I'll escalate to Eng leads and schedule a hard gating call.

Maya: lgtm, keeping this thread as the single source of truth for cross-team deps.

SRE-Bot: Reminder: create incident runbook if canary error rate threshold triggers during rollout.

Samir: will add runbook snippet to the PR.

Alex: Closing loop: next sync Friday 09:30 PT. If nothing changes, we'll treat the dates above as committed milestones.
